3.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses, and no sentence over 14 words. Selah is written Selah (pause and think), as in the Psalms. V17-18 keep the KJV's Yet I will rejoice in the LORD.

verses.text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth (a kind of song).
O LORD, I have heard Your speech, and was afraid. O LORD, revive (bring to life) Your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath (anger) remember mercy.
God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah (pause and think). His glory covered the heavens. And the earth was full of His praise.
And His brightness was as the light. He had horns (rays of light) coming out of His hand. And there was the hiding of His power.
Before Him went the pestilence (deadly sickness). And burning coals went forth (out) at His feet.

He stood, and measured the earth. He beheld (looked), and drove asunder (scattered) the nations. And the everlasting mountains were scattered. The perpetual (old) hills did bow. His ways are everlasting.
I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction (trouble). And the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble (shake).
Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? Was Your anger against the rivers? Was Your wrath (anger) against the sea? You did ride upon Your horses and Your chariots of salvation (rescue).
Your bow was made quite naked (uncovered). It was according to the oaths (promises) of the tribes, even Your word. Selah (pause and think). You did cleave (split) the earth with rivers.
The mountains saw You, and they trembled (shook). The overflowing of the water passed by. The deep uttered (lifted) his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
The sun and moon stood still in their habitation (place). At the light of Your arrows they went. They went at the shining of Your glittering spear.
You did march through the land in indignation (anger). You did thresh (beat) the heathen (nations) in anger.

You went forth (out) for the salvation (rescue) of Your people. You went for salvation with Your anointed (chosen one). You wounded the head out of the house of the wicked. You discovered (bared) the foundation to the neck. Selah (pause and think).
You did strike through with his staves (spears) the head of his villages. They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me. Their rejoicing was as to devour (eat up) the poor secretly.
You did walk through the sea with Your horses. You walked through the heap of great waters.

When I heard, my belly trembled (shook). My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself. I trembled so that I might rest in the day of trouble. The enemy comes up to the people. He will invade them with his troops.

The fig tree may not blossom, and fruit may not be in the vines. The labour (crop) of the olive may fail. The fields may yield no meat (food). The flock may be cut off from the fold (sheep pen). And there may be no herd in the stalls.
Yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will joy in the God of my salvation.
The LORD God is my strength. And He will make my feet like hinds' feet (deer's feet). And He will make me to walk upon my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
